The latest survey from The Economist/YouGov, published Monday, found 33 percent of respondents said they approved of how Trump has handled his job as president. Another 62 percent indicated they disapproved.

Support for the president was split largely along partisan lines, with 79 percent of GOP respondents and only 4 percent of Democratic respondents approving of Trump’s job performance, according to the poll. results.content:
July 28, 2026

Americans' approval of Donald Trump's job performance continues to decline, according to the July 25 - 27 Economist / YouGov Poll. 34% of U.S. adult citizens strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, tied for a record low for either Trump term, while a record 62% disapprove. That's a net job approval of -28, also a record low.

At this point in Trump's first term, he had a net job approval of -9.
results.title: Trump's job approval hits record low, driven down by Gen X, white Americans, and Independents
